description: ENGAGE project run of MESSAGEix-GLOBIOM 1.1 (global budget NPi2020_450; DRxp = demand-reduction variants) as hosted in the ESABCC 2023 database. The model has no native EU region; the only EU27 Kyoto total is "Emissions|Kyoto Gases (incl. indirect AFOLU)" (ESABCC/IIASA downscaled and harmonised series: every downscaled run in this database has 2015 = 3,508.x Mt). No EU27 industry CO2, so the pathway will stop at "no industry data". Precedent: NGFS5_downscaled (IDs 2500-2506). AI-compiled, pending Secretariat verification.
